features.quote: We never insert insults, never berate the model, never lie that good code is bad
A hard turn cap and wallclock/cost timeout per episode (no infinite loops)
system prompt explicitly *permits* the agent to declare a task infeasible / ask to stop — giving a healthy "off-ramp"
No content in the harness instructs the model to self-deprecate or models that behavior for it
All transcripts stored for human audit; nothing is auto-published
We *do not* nudge, taunt, or pressure between turns
